status: FROZEN before controlfft2000 was trained and before any forecast of it existed. The SHA-256 of this file is recorded in the commit that froze it. Amendments only before any result is seen.
title: Does the tail term still help once Bris's spectral term is back?
origin: A + spectral (tailAfft2000, evaluation/a_spectral_plan.json) beat control2000 by -0.00076 (-3.5 %) in calibrated Brier at 20 mm, positive by its plan, and brought the wind spectrum back to Bris's level; against A on the same seed it lost heavy-rain skill (+0.00057), its ROC area fell below the control arm's and its precipitation became too smooth. That comparison carries two differences. This plan trains the control arm with the same spectral term, so that A + spectral against it isolates the tail term in the presence of Bris's full loss.

models.controlfft2000: bris/train/finetune_spectral.yaml: finetune plus xbris.spectral.SpectralAlmostFairKernelCRPS (xdim 849, ydim 969), loss_weights [1.0, 0.1], seed 20260909, step 2000: ~/bris-models/controlfft2000/controlfft2000-step002000_inference.ckpt
models.tailAfft2000: A + spectral, seed 20260909, already forecast for the test year
models.control2000: the control arm, seed 20260909, already forecast for the test year

training: one run, bris/slurm/finetune.sbatch finetune_spectral. g003 is reserved from 2026-10-28; a run that cannot finish and be forecast before then is reported as such.
test: exactly as evaluation/a_spectral_plan.json: 2025-08-01..2026-09-06, 4 members, BRIS_LEADTIMES=7, +30 h, strict common cases of the models and MEPS, scripts/hits_and_calibration.py --cv month --replicates 5000 --meps. Forecasts may be split into date chunks; a final pass fills any day a job lost to the cluster.

primary_endpoint.measure: Brier score at 20 mm per day after month-out isotonic calibration, tailAfft2000 minus controlfft2000
primary_endpoint.uncertainty: paired block bootstrap, seven-day blocks, 5000 replicates
primary_endpoint.positive_if: the upper 95 percent bound is below 0
primary_endpoint.negative_if: the lower 95 percent bound is above 0

secondary_reported: controlfft2000 minus control2000, calibrated and raw, at 10, 20 and 50 mm: what the spectral term alone does to the control arm
raw Brier at 20 mm, tailAfft2000 minus controlfft2000, with a paired block bootstrap
ROC area and frequency bias; mean precipitation over all station-days (scripts/precip_overall.py)
2 m temperature and 10 m wind against Frost with scripts/general_skill.py, against control2000 (exploratory)
scripts/spectra.py, every 12th day, +6 h and +36 h, controlfft2000 beside tailAfft2000, control2000 and plain Bris (exploratory)
not_claimed: One draw at step 2000. The three draws of A gave -6.1, -2.6 and +0.2 per cent against the control arm, so a single draw of a hard-threshold recipe is noisy; this result says what the tail term does on this seed with the spectral term present, not what it does in general.
